title: BisonFi (Solana dark-amm RFQ v3 prop-AMM) — live E-U $0; the 2026-03-28 'BisonFi drain' was GoonFi-side mispricing with BisonFi as fair-priced exit venue; code-level upgrade history; single-EOA upgrade key (P)
closed_reasons: Swap pricing is oracle-bounded: output deviation >3% from the publisher oracle returns 0 (no trade); measured executions: $105.32-105.41/SOL vs oracle $105.4159
Tight freshness gate: pool state must be updated within ~2 slots of the current clock; stale states (incl. the old $4.94M pool) refuse all swaps
Pool-state mutation paths (disc 16/20/27) reject unauthorized signers with Custom(2)/Custom(0); the state stores the per-pool MM authority pubkey
Publisher feed program (dijkbk) requires the updater key FTp1BybZ... signature (MissingRequiredSignature otherwise) — feed not spoofable without the key
March 28 exploit re-priced: BisonFi leg paid $82.6926/WSOL vs market $82.7311 (fair); the mispricing was GoonFi's leg at $2.6610/WSOL — no BisonFi-side profit in the replay template
key_facts: Pool 8FnX3xo2 (SOL-USDC-Pool2) at slot 457,433,682: 21,259.57 WSOL + 2,395,920.92 USDC = $4,637,065 at SOL $105.4159 (publisher feed)

caveats: The exact March-era ELF was not byte-diffed (buffer-chunk reconstruction documented as follow-up; upgrade timeline + interface change + in-code controls used as evidence instead)

A single 'Custom(1)' size-cap failure appeared after cumulative in-process trades; it did not reproduce after opposite-direction flow and never yielded extraction — flagged as a state-consistency guard, not a finding
P-class value (9,575,674) = fresh-verified vaults under the program (8FnX3xo2 + 51FQwjr); the upgrade key also controls the remaining fleet vaults (~$18.6M cached total)
LiteSVM CU accounting differs from mainnet on the no-code feed path (4 vs 24 CU); verdicts use success/failure + state diffs
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from BisonFi's $4.64M pool: the swap path is oracle-bounded (±3%), freshness-gated (≤2 slots), and all state/feed writes are signature-gated; the March 28 replay template's profit was GoonFi-side (BisonFi paid fair value), and the $18.6M fleet is exposed only to the single-EOA upgrade key and the single-key publisher feed (P-class).
